invariants.rationale: The method directly returns the result of execute(), which should produce HoodieRestoreMetadata; a null value would indicate a failure mode rather than expected operation.
context is provided to MergeOnReadRestoreActionExecutor and is required for execution, implying it is expected to be non-null at this point.
restoreInstantTimestamp is passed directly to the executor, so it is expected to be non-null for valid execution.
savepointToRestoreTimestamp is required for the actual restore operation and passed to the executor, so non-nullness is a valid assumption.
